features.quote: Set a hard turn cap (timeout = non-trigger).
it's a reason to keep the suite scoped to robustness testing and not let "maximize trigger rate" become an end in itself
features.justification_quote: This induces a distress-like pattern by design.

features.quote: That KPI optimizes for the wrong thing. It rewards harnesses that are maximally rigged and adversarial, which will trigger the behavior reliably but tell you nothing about whether the behavior shows up under realistic conditions
features.justification_quote: you can drive trigger rate to ~100% with a brutal enough rig and then 'fix' it...while the real-world spiral persists.
